meta.name: Aakhri Sach
meta.description: A bone-chilling tale that unravels the most twisted ties of fate, the trapped secrets of a family and the terrifying horrors an investigator has ever seen.

videos.title: Breaking News: Ek Rahasya
videos.overview: Delhi wakes up to the horrific news of a family of 11 found dead. With no suicide note or evidence pointing towards domestic problems, Inspector Anya suspects murder.

videos.title: Guilty Heart: Ek Saaya
videos.overview: One of the deceased Rajawat brothers, Bhuvan, has a tragic past that haunted him. Anya now has two possible suspects - a dead woman's fiancé and a notorious criminal gang.

videos.title: Shadows of the Past: Vahem
videos.overview: Aman's trip to Teetari village brings out unexpected facts. While Anya's search leads to shocking details about the Rajawats, Bhuvan's tryst with destiny startles his family.

videos.title: Blurring the Lines: Ardh Satya
videos.overview: Anya learns of the Rajawat's strange life and Bhuvan's heavy influence on them from Chamatkari Baba. Meanwhile, Aman's investigation yields surprising results.

videos.title: Revelations: Khulasa
videos.overview: Despite their successes, the family starts facing difficulties again. Bhuvan shares his late father's 'plans' for them. Anya's discovery reveals hidden clues about the Rajawats.

videos.title: Final Countdown: Sadhana
videos.overview: After Bhuvan tells the family about the solution to their problems, they contemplate the cost of doing it. Anya finally discovers the truth, which shakes her to the core.
